meta.name: review-report
meta.description: Use when you want the rich human-facing code review experience — a walkthrough with prose explanation plus mermaid architecture/sequence diagrams plus an HTML report of verified findings, not just terminal findings. Triggers include "review report", "코드리뷰 리포트", "리뷰 HTML", "다이어그램 리뷰", "리뷰 다이어그램", "walkthrough 리뷰", "PR 리뷰 리포트".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带图表和HTML报告的可读代码审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要生成详细、可分享的代码审查报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate readable code reviews with diagrams and HTML reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed, shareable code review reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 收到代码审查请求时，会分析代码差异，生成包含文字总结、架构图和序列图的步行通过说明，再调用审查代理获取验证结果，最后输出一份独立的 HTML 报告。
howto.when: 当你要求“审查报告”、“代码审查报告”，或提供 PR 编号、分支比较等时触发。

say.text: 对 PR #123 生成代码审查报告。
say.note: 输出包含步行通过和验证结果的HTML。

say.text: 对比 main 和 feature/auth 分支，生成审查报告。
say.note: 基于分支差异生成报告。

howto.what_en: When installed, upon receiving a code review request, Claude analyzes the diff, synthesizes a walkthrough with prose, architecture and sequence diagrams, dispatches a reviewer agent for verified findings, and produces a standalone HTML report instead of terminal output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "review report" or provide a PR number, branch comparison, or similar review request.

say_en.text: Generate a review report for PR #123.
say_en.note: Produces an HTML report with walkthrough and findings.

say_en.text: Compare main and feature/auth branches and generate a review report.
